Session  3  Storytelling  
●  Storytelling  vocabulary  ●  Phrases  and  exclamations  
 Homework  
●  Write  a  short  story  (100–120  words)  titled  "The  Day  Everything  Went  Wrong."  
Include:  
-  A  clear  beginning,  middle,  and  end  
-  At  least  three  past-tense  verbs  (e.g.,  forgot,  spilled,  missed)  
-  One  exclamation  with  "How"  (e.g.,  How  embarrassing!)  
-  One  modal  verb  (e.g.,  could,  might,  should)  
-  Use  descriptive  adjectives  to  bring  the  story  to  life  
-  Correct  your  story  using  an  AI  Tool
